propositions: _convert resolves _pandoc_timeout() on every per-unit invocation, causing 886 redundant git rev-parse --show-toplevel subprocesses across 884 production conversions.

Timeout and repository-root discovery are loop/session invariants that can be resolved once at render-pass boundary and threaded through optional parameters without changing output bytes, fallback behavior, or process-group reap semantics.
The sole production caller (_render_unit) and all direct test callers depend on timeout value and output behavior, not on the frequency of config lookups.

Resolving timeout once per render pass and passing it through optional parameters to _render_unit and _convert reduces subprocess count from 1,770 to 887 (884 Pandoc + 3 cold root probes) while preserving all 884 real Pandoc invocations and byte-equivalent outputs.
Direct callers (e.g., test_wiki_render_corpus.py:325) retain safe default behavior via optional parameters when timeout is not explicitly provided.
Per-unit timeout fallback, Pandoc stdin/argv behavior, byte-equivalence assertions, and process-group reaping remain fully covered by test suite.
